pkgmetadata.longdescription: draw.io (diagrams.net) is a diagramming web application. This package installs the official prebuilt server WAR distribution for self-hosting under a servlet container such as Tomcat. It is a distinct product from the Electron-based desktop application (packaged elsewhere as drawio-desktop, e.g. app-office/drawio-desktop-bin in the Gentoo main tree).
